offers.label: What We Offer
offers.headline: Pick the format that fits your project.
offers.copy: All formats include fast delivery and press-ready output.

offer-exhibition.blurb: Full coverage from opening night through the run. Delivered for press releases, funding applications, and archive. The gallery stays open in your files long after it closes.

offer-session.blurb: Studio and location sessions for musicians and visual artists building a body of work. Images that represent the practice, not just the person.

offer-performance.blurb: Multi-angle documentation for a single show or a full season. Delivered within 24–48h. Built for socials, press kits, and everything that needs to move fast.

offer-brand.blurb: Editorial documentation for brand events, launches, and activations. Clean, sharp, on deadline. The kind of coverage your client expects.
